title: Five More Minutes plugin manifest (schema version 1)
description: The file `fmm-plugin.json` at the root of a plugin's repository. Everything a family needs to decide whether to add a plugin, as strict data: nothing in it is ever interpreted as markup or code by the marketplace or the portal.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema. Always 1 for now.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Unique in the registry, and the folder name of the listing. It is also what a key made for the plugin is labelled with.

name.description: What people see. Plain text, no angle brackets.

description.description: A short paragraph on what the plugin does, in plain text. Separate paragraphs with a blank line.

license.description: An SPDX license identifier, such as MIT or Apache-2.0.

repository.description: The plugin's own git repository. GitHub only, for now.

documentation.description: Where the full documentation lives. Usually the repository's README.

icon.description: Always `icon.png` at the root of the repository: a square PNG between 128 and 512 pixels, under 100 KB. SVG is not accepted, because it can carry script.

platform.description: Where the plugin runs: "Home Assistant", "Homey", "Docker". Shown so a family knows what they need.

permissions.description: What the plugin's key may do to the one computer it is made for, and why. The parent sees this before agreeing, and the service refuses anything outside it.

reason.description: Why the plugin needs it, in a sentence a parent can weigh.

steps.description: Installation instructions, one step at a time. `{{FMM_URL}}` and `{{API_KEY}}` are filled in by the portal after the parent adds the plugin.

apiVersion.description: The major version of the Five More Minutes plugin API the plugin uses. /api/integrations/v1 is 1.

httpsUrl.description: An https address with a real host name: no credentials, no IP address, no whitespace.
